instruction: Visualize the three-month trend for each row by placing bar chart sparklines directly within the corresponding cells.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Calc does not support embedded bar charts as sparklines within individual cells through standard operations. While full charts can be created as separate objects, inline sparkline-style visualizations within cells would require extensions or complex workarounds that cannot be automated reliably. This maintains the same infeasibility level as the original task.
